evals.prompt: Our Vite site on GitHub Pages at github.io/my-repo/ — clicking nav goes to github.io/packages instead of github.io/my-repo/packages. wsx-router has mode=hash. Fix?
evals.expected_output: wsx-router ignores hash mode; use Vite base /my-repo/ and sitePath() on all wsx-link/wsx-view; do not rely on hash routing.

evals.prompt: GH Pages build loads locales from /locales/en/common.json and 404s. We patched fetch globally. Better approach?
evals.expected_output: Remove fetch patch; set i18n loadPath with import.meta.env.BASE_URL; resolve base via GITHUB_PAGES env in vite.config.

evals.prompt: Deep link refresh on GitHub Pages project site 404s. Current 404.html has a redirect script stripping the path.
evals.expected_output: Replace redirect with plain copy of index.html; History API SPA fallback; ensure vite base is /repo/.

evals.prompt: Our wsx-press 0.2.0 docs break under /my-repo/. We use a custom Vite transform plugin to rewrite /.wsx-press and /docs paths. What is the supported fix?
evals.expected_output: Remove wsxPressBasePlugin; import configurePressBase from @wsxjs/wsx-press/client/paths in a side-effect init module; call it with import.meta.env.BASE_URL before importing or mounting wsx-press components; keep sitePath() for wsx-router routes.
